title: View command-line history
summary: Show a list of commands you have typed in the terminal. This helps you find a command you used recently or remember what you did.

steps.explain: Display the full list of commands from your session history with line numbers.
steps.expect: A numbered list of previously executed commands appears.

steps.explain: Alternatively, display only the last 20 commands to see recent activity.
steps.expect: A numbered list of the last 20 commands appears.
